title: Fitness & Business: Ever Bilena President Denice Sy on Her Chicago Marathon Experience
summary: Ever Bilena has always celebrated the real Filipina. We are hardworking, we juggle a lot and we can still show up beautifully. Fitness showed me that strength is beautiful, too.
